caption: One muxed-D scan cell. With SE = 1 the multiplexer chooses SI, so the flip-flops form a shift register; with SE = 0 the cell takes functional D.

spec.title: One muxed-D scan cell
spec.aria: A flip-flop preceded by a multiplexer that chooses between the functional data input and the scan-in input, with the Q output feeding the next cell of the chain.
